cases.name: squat day in kg with a check-in 30 min before: attached, set converted lb to kg
cases.reason: settings unit kg, 3 sets of 225 lb x 5 at RPE 8. 225 * 0.45359237 = 102.05828325, rounded to 4 decimals = 102.0583. Fatigue: set_factor(8) = 1 + 0.1*(8-8) = 1 per set; squat targets quads (3 sets x 1 = 3) and has synergists hamstrings, glutes, calves (3 x 0.5 = 1.5 each). Fitness = volume / max(1, 100) = (102.0583 * 5 * 3) / 100 = 15.308745000000002. quadSetEq 3, heavyLower true. The check-in (17:00, 30 min before) attaches to the lift, so prsHistory and lastCheckin carry the session date and sorenessPrev is the check-in's soreness.

cases.name: rest-day check-in two days after the lift decays the state first, then records
cases.reason: Same session in lb. The check-in is after the lift, so it is standalone: state decays 2 days to 2026-10-03T17:30. quads 3 * exp(-2/2.5) = 1.3479868923516647; hamstrings, glutes, calves 1.5 * exp(-2/2.5) = 0.6739934461758323 (tau 2.5 d). Fitness in lb: (225*5*3)/100 = 33.75, times exp(-2/45) (tau 45 d) = 32.28284494472724. updated moves to the check-in, prsHistory gets the check-in's own date, one lift session only.

cases.name: a kg-logged set in an lb history divides by 0.45359237
cases.reason: 100 kg / 0.45359237 = 220.46226218..., rounded to 4 decimals = 220.4623. One set of 5: fitness = 220.4623 * 5 / 100 = 11.023115. RPE absent and no target: set_factor = 1, so quads 1 and each synergist 0.5.

cases.name: stub dropped and an unknown exercise warns
cases.reason: A stub lift (programDayIndex 3) adds nothing; the second session is an exercise id that is not in the library, so it adds no fatigue but is still a logged session (liftSessions has exactly one entry) and the warning is 'unknown exercise: zzz' once even though both its entries use it.

cases.reason: No records: initial state (updated at the epoch, zero systemic fatigue) with mainLifts from the settings.
